title: UFO Abductee Describes Horrifying Captors | UFO Witness | Travel Channel
description:
Former FBI agent and UFO Witness host Ben Hansen is in Pascagoula, Mississippi to interview Calvin Parker, who was involved in a 1973 UFO abduction case. Calvin tells his astonishing story of his first-hand experience being abducted and goes into detail about what happened. Calvin's accounts of the events are both fascinating and chilling, and Ben is determined to bring knowledge of these abductions to the public.

Former federal agent Ben Hansen is on a mission to uncover the truth behind UFO sightings across America. With unprecedented access to the archives of the late Dr. J. Allen Hynek, chief scientific adviser of Project Blue Book, Ben unlocks the secrets of the past to shed light on today's UFO encounters.
